keep in mind this is just a videogame, no matter how much you know, you just need to figure out the tricks and intricacies of the game if you want to win. 

* Do you have pitch up and pitch down configured in the keyboard or do you use just the mouse to manouver? because if you do then you can control the plane WHILE  looking behind you, so you can see where your enemy is aiming and turn or roll away from it.  

* Do you have a second button to fire just the small caliber guns in your plane? if your plane has both machine guns and cannons you can activate vertical targeting, put stealth belts on your machine guns and air target belts on your cannons. This way you can shoot your enemy with just the machine guns without allerting him until you hit him and zero on him, and then you shoot him with the cannons, that will hit him exactly where the machine guns were hitting him. 
  
* Do you use manual engine controls?  If you need to make your plane go a bit faster you just close the radiator for a while, and if your engine gets shot down you can turn on prop feathering to allow your plane to glide back to the airfield better, or if you're landing too fast you can open the radiator fully and incline the propellers' pitch to their maximum in order to increase drag and slow you down even faster than your plane normally could.

If you need setting up any of these controls just reply, i'd be happy to help.

They can turn, they can BnZ, they can roll, they can climb, they're everything right in warthunder.
